name: off_by_one_loop
description: Believes a for loop over i < n runs n+1 times, or that i <= n is needed to reach n.

name: loop_includes_last
description: Believes a loop that steps by one skips the last item or runs one extra time.

name: counter_vs_sum
description: Confuses the count of iterations with the accumulated total.

name: comparison_is_assignment
description: Reads == (compare) as = (assign) in a condition.

name: else_if_confusion
description: Believes separate if statements are mutually exclusive, or that else pairs with the first if.

name: int_division
description: Believes dividing two ints always gives a fractional result, or that / truncates.

name: scanf_format_mismatch
description: Believes scanf reads a value into a variable without the & address.

name: string_length_off_by_one
description: Believes strlen counts one fewer or one more than the string has.

name: missing_null_terminator
description: Forgets that a char array needs a trailing NUL byte to be a string.

name: array_index_off_by_one
description: Believes the first element of an array has index 1, or that index length is valid.

name: array_bound_no_check
description: Believes reading past the end of an array is safe or returns 0.

name: pointer_offset_vs_value
description: Confuses the value a pointer holds with the value at the address it points to.

name: uninitialized_pointer
description: Dereferences a pointer before it points anywhere.

name: pass_by_value
description: Believes a function can rebind the caller's variable by reassigning its argument.

name: return_vs_print
description: Confuses printing a value with returning it to the caller.

name: missing_base_case
description: Forgets the base case, so a recursive function never stops.

name: missing_recursive_return
description: Forgets to return the value of the recursive call.

name: struct_copy_by_value
description: Does not realise that assigning a struct copies all its fields.

name: dot_vs_arrow
description: Confuses . (on a struct) with -> (through a pointer to a struct).

name: use_after_free
description: Reads a pointer after the memory it pointed to has been freed.

name: double_free
description: Frees the same pointer twice.

name: struct_copy_is_alias
description: Believes assigning one struct to another makes both names refer to the same data.

name: struct_member_needs_pointer
description: Believes a struct member can only be reached through a pointer.

name: malloc_counts_bytes_as_items
description: Believes malloc(n) gives room for n integers rather than n bytes.

name: use_after_free
description: Believes memory is still safe to use after free, or that free clears the pointer.

name: struct_init_ignored
description: Believes a struct's initial values are ignored and its members start at zero.

name: compound_update_resets
description: Believes updating a member through a pointer sets it to the increment.

name: sizeof_is_one_item
description: Believes n * sizeof(int) is the size of a single int.

name: comparison_prints_word
description: Believes printing a comparison shows the word it compares against.
